sources.title: openadmet/pxr-chemeleon-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We have updated our microsomal clearance model with the latest available public data from our OpenADMET PXR Blind Challenge. This is model is a single task CheMeleon model trained on pEC50 data generated by Octant for PXR.
